send.param: The id of the event to reply to, sends a message to the room. The reply stays in the thread of that event and mentions its sender, like replies in Element do.
send.returns: A task that completes once the message is queued. For replies the SDK loads the replied-to event first, which can take a request to the server.

remarks.para: The message is added to the send queue of the room and shows up in the timeline right away as a local echo, the SDK sends it in the background and retries when the connection fails. Whether it was sent shows in the of the echo, errors are also reported by . Use and instead when you need the to abort or retry sending.

send.exception: The message couldn't be queued, for example because the event to reply to wasn't found or is a state event.
